headline: Wardens Sweep Weathered Expanse; Linn Mercy Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has been overturned: Warden flags now fly over six of its nine strongpoints against a lone Colonial post, two grounds in ruin, with Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance the busiest points and the midday flood of casualties cooled markedly. On the Nevish Line the Colonials have clawed back to two postings, no base now listed in ruin; sixty-nine flag actions in a day, Blackcoat Way and Princefal the busiest, keep that front seething, with day losses near seven thousand a side. Linn Mercy's flags have been still for two hours, yet its casualty ledger is the war's heaviest — above nine hundred Warden and five hundred Colonial in the past hour and climbing — with Lathair the focal ground. Kuura Strand has been quiet since nightfall, five Colonial posts and one ruin unmoved. Stlican Shelf and Callahans Passage show no flag movements but heavy loss rolls; Marban Hollow remains silent since morning; elsewhere the maps are largely still. It is day 703; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize and no victor is declared.
